_release_name: PYRO-ASTRA NASA PSI Microgravity Fire Safety Data Release v1.0
_license_statement: There are no restrictions on the use of this data. (Registry of Open Data on AWS, https://registry.opendata.aws/nasa-psi/)

artifacts.description: Complete flattened CSV export of all 18 NASA PSI investigations with column-level provenance
Grounded physical condition extractions with verbatim quotes, source files, and JSON key paths
Hand-verified flight test matrix of 20 BASS-II solid burn tests from NASA/TM-20210011385 Table 5.1
Standardized alias for BASS-II Table 5.1 flight test matrix (20 tests)
Standardized tabular dataset of 1,843 experimental test runs with 44 physical columns and row-level SHA-256 provenance
Machine-readable array of 1,843 experimental test runs with schema definitions and Rule G1 enforcement metadata
Comprehensive availability catalog, S3 endpoints, GEODE status, and DOI verification for all 18 investigations
Complete field definitions, physical units, data types, and provenance constraints
Comprehensive scientific dataset card documenting investigations, 1,843 runs, G1 rules, and machine learning guidelines
Formal scientific dataset card documenting scope, sources, extraction methodology, and known gaps
NASA PSI Open Data terms, Registry of Open Data on AWS statement, and PYRO-ASTRA MIT license
